subject: Construct visibly populated Westside Watch homepage v0.2
body: Build the visibly populated Westside Watch homepage using the deterministic v0.2 construction path. The board must not be blank. Require visible masthead, navigation, gold rule, hero title/deck, Watch Night 5:8 field, Morning Gold accent, editorial gold block, Chinese feature title, lower rule, and editorial passage. Obtain the real board id and export that exact board as PNG for visual verification.
design_brief: Westside Watch: Living Paper #FAF9F5, Ink #252525, First Light Gold #A2872A, Morning Gold #D2BC69, Watch Night #102A43. Quiet, intelligent, spacious, architectural editorial composition. A blank white board is a hard failure.
